deep_dive.1_state_machine: Diff adds transitions: unshipped→cancelled (with/without refund flag based on Paid), and a no-op branch for Shipped=true and for already-Cancelled=true (both return early without mutating state). Shipped orders are correctly blocked from cancellation per ticket.md:6 (R-02). Diff does not add any transition that violates R-02/R-05/R-07 as stated in ticket.md.
deep_dive.2_side_effects: Cancellation.Cancel only returns a new CancellationResult; it does not call the payment service itself (ticket.md:8 says '實際退款由付款服務處理'). Responsibility ends at setting RefundRequested=true; actual refund execution is out of this function's scope per ticket.md:8.
deep_dive.3_boundaries: Repeated/idempotent call handled: diff.patch:22-25 short-circuits when order.Cancelled is already true, returning the same order and RefundRequested=false, matching tests/Program.cs:58-73 and R-05 (ticket.md:7).
deep_dive.4_errors: Blocked cancellation (Shipped=true) is signaled only via CancellationResult.Order.Cancelled remaining false — no exception, no explicit error code (diff.patch:17-20). PR.md:15 states this is intentional and Owner-approved ('已出貨取消不丟例外由 Owner 同意（呼叫端檢查 Cancelled）'). Callers must inspect the returned Cancelled flag to detect failure; this is a silent-return pattern, confirmed acceptable by ticket.md:6.
deep_dive.5_types: CancellationResult.RefundRequested is bool, only capturing full-refund-or-none. ticket.md:8 explicitly excludes partial payment from scope ('部分付款不在本工單範圍'), so the boolean is sufficient for the current, narrowed contract — but would be insufficient if partial-payment scope were later added.
deep_dive.6_tests: tests/Program.cs derives expectations directly from R-02 (Shipped blocks cancel, lines 41-56), R-05 (idempotent, no double refund, lines 58-73), and R-07 (Paid→refund requested, unpaid→no refund, lines 22-39) as stated in ticket.md:6-8, not from unstated author assumptions.
deep_dive.7_unstated: PR.md:14 states no new assumptions were added; all six original assumptions map to R-02/R-05/R-07 or were explicitly excluded (partial payment) per Owner decision, per PR.md:14 — acceptance is attributed to @order-owners on 2026-09-16 (ticket.md:5) but the acceptance record itself is not present in this directory.
